explanation: Its fame owes much to the Swiss Cheese Union, a cheese-marketing body that promoted fondue as the national dish to sell more cheese.

claims.text: Cheese fondue is a Swiss dish eaten by dipping bread on long forks into a shared pot of melted cheese.
Raclette (melted cheese scraped onto potatoes), rosti (fried grated potato) and croque monsieur (a toasted ham and cheese sandwich) are not eaten by dipping bread into a shared pot of melted cheese.
The Swiss Cheese Union, a cheese-marketing body, promoted fondue as Switzerland's national dish in order to increase cheese sales.
